purpose: Measure whether the graph-qualified P8 small-M scheduler is selected in TP4 GLM serving and recovers full-model C1 decode throughput.

candidate.codec: K4 procedural MCG to E4M3, physical UE8M0/32, identity boundary, 4.25 routed bpw

decision_rule: Integration closes only if all 168 layer/rank first-forward receipts select small_m_scheduler=true, FULL CUDA graphs are proven by logs, the benchmark completes, and no thermal abort occurs. The original product gate remains failed unless the measured C1 decode rate exceeds 91.2645 tokens/s; a single run can diagnose recovery but cannot replace the required five-cold-run product comparison.
